tool_args.query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inspection_date) AS yr, COUNT(*) FROM inspections GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;

WITH recent_inspections AS (
    SELECT 
        i.inspection_id,
        i.slchd_establishment_key,
        i.inspection_date,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) AS critical_count
    FROM inspections i
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE i.inspection_date >= '2020-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.slchd_establishment_key, i.inspection_date
),
first_and_last AS (
    SELECT 
        slchd_establishment_key,
        FIRST(critical_count ORDER BY inspection_date ASC) as initial_critical,
        LAST(critical_count ORDER BY inspection_date ASC) as recent_critical,
        FIRST(inspection_date ORDER BY inspection_date ASC) as first_date,
        LAST(inspection_date ORDER BY inspection_date ASC) as last_date,
        COUNT(*) as total_inspections
    FROM recent_inspections
    GROUP BY slchd_establishment_key
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT 
    ek.name,
    fl.slchd_establishment_key,
    fl.first_date,
    fl.initial_critical,
    fl.last_date,
    fl.recent_critical,
    (fl.recent_critical - fl.initial_critical) as critical_change,
    fl.total_inspections
FROM first_and_last fl
JOIN establishment_keys ek ON fl.slchd_establishment_key = ek.slchd_establishment_key
ORDER BY critical_change DESC
LIMIT 20;

),

        FIRST(inspection_date ORDER BY inspection_date ASC) as first_insp_date,
        LAST(inspection_date ORDER BY inspection_date ASC) as last_insp_date,
        COUNT(*) as total_inspections,
